key_insight: A context-augmented LLM can combine alternative data and traditional financial information in-context to improve firm revenue forecasting.
engineering_relevance: The paper suggests a flexible, low-retuning forecasting pipeline for heterogeneous, sparse, and channel-specific business data sources.
method: Two-agent framework first screens which firms each alternative data channel is likely to help.
Uses firm- and channel-specific context to prompt the LLM for revenue prediction.
Compares forecasts across four commercial alternative data channels against standard baselines.
evidence_signal: Across four commercial alternative data channels, adding alternative data to financial context improved LLM forecasts and outperformed standard forecasting baselines.
watch_item: Performance may depend on limited historical coverage and careful selection of which firms and channels are truly informative.
paper_title: Making Alternative Data Work: Context-Augmented LLMs for Financial Forecasting
